title: Agent Archive eval export record
description: One line of `agent-archive eval export` output (JSON Lines): a session record or an error record, told apart by `record`. Every field is built from data agent-archive has already filtered: a metadata sidecar, a verified source bundle, or a local transcript filtered as the collector filters it. See dev/specs/eval-export.md for the stability promise: fields are only added within a schema_version; removing, renaming, or changing the meaning of one bumps it.

detail.description: 'metadata': no conversation text; for an archived session every field comes from its metadata sidecar and no source bundle is read. 'full': adds prompts, final_response, files_edited, and feedback, read from the filtered source.

session_id.description: The archive session ID for source 'archive'; the app's own session ID for source 'local'.

transcript_path.description: Source 'local' only: the transcript's absolute path on this machine, which is also what --ids-from accepts to export it again.

machine_id.description: Source 'archive' only: the machine that captured the session.

parent_session_id.description: Set for a subagent session: its parent's session ID.

name.description: Base name of the project root.

root.description: Source 'local' only: the project root's absolute path on this machine. Never present for source 'archive', whose sidecars hold no paths.

branch.description: The first git branch the retained transcript records (Claude Code's gitBranch): the branch the session started on. Absent when none is recorded (Codex, Cursor) and at metadata detail for source 'archive', which reads no transcript.

git_head.description: As in the metadata sidecar. Absent for source 'local': a transcript file records no commit, and agent-archive does not guess one.

replay.description: As in the metadata sidecar. Absent for source 'local': the marker is recorded only by a hook.

captured_at.description: Source 'archive' only: when the published snapshot was captured.

prompts.description: Detail 'full' only, and then always present: every human prompt, filtered, in session order. Harness-written records (expanded skills, command output, notifications, compaction summaries) are not prompts.

final_response.description: Detail 'full' only: the last assistant text in the transcript, or, when it has none, the last final message a stop hook reported (source 'hook'). Absent when there is neither.

files_edited.description: Detail 'full' only, and then always present: the distinct files the session's editing calls named, in the order first edited, relative to the session's working directory when inside it. counts.files_touched counts the same files.

feedback.description: Detail 'full' only: explicit feedback attached with `agent-archive feedback`, filtered, in order. Absent when there is none, and always for source 'local'.

trimmed.description: Present only when --max-bytes cut the record: the longest texts were halved (never below 256 bytes, never dropped, each marked truncated), then edited files were dropped from the end. exceeds_max_bytes says the record is still over the bound.

error.description: Written in place of a session that could not be exported. It never fails the rest of the export.

input.description: What was asked for, as given: a session ID or a transcript path.

code.description: A reader must accept any other lowercase code, which a later release may add.

message.description: For people; names no transcript content.
